latestVersion.changelog:
- Initial release of mugshot-creator-openapi-skill.
- Generate police-style mugshot photos from portrait images using WeShop OpenAPI.
- Includes secure API key handling (WESHOP_API_KEY) and HTTPS access requirements.
- Supports single image input, custom mugshot instructions, and batch image generation.
- Endpoints for run management and image upload are documented.
- Results are available via polling run status until completion.
